title: Quantifying Geospatial in the Common Crawl Corpus

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating the prevalence of geospatial data (street addresses and geographic coordinates) in the Common Crawl pre-training corpus by sampling documents, extracting location entities using an LLM (Gemini 1.5 Flash), and analyzing representation disparities across different Top-Level Domains (TLDs) to identify geographic over- or under-representation.

Comparing the frequency and type of embedded geospatial data (e.g., coordinates vs. addresses) between English-language and non-English-language web documents to evaluate representational imbalances in the training corpus.
